name: UpdateCustomAttribute

parameters.help_en: The new display name for the custom attribute. It must be 128 characters or less
parameters.help_zh: 新的自定义属性展示名称，长度小于128个字符
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en:
The applicable entity types. This parameter supports specific types and wildcard formats, such as `*-table` and `*-column`. For example:

- `dataworks-project`: A DataWorks workspace

- `dataworks-dataset`: A DataWorks dataset

- `maxcompute-table`: A MaxCompute table

- `*-column`: All column types
parameters.help_zh:
适用实体类型列表，支持精确实体类型以及 `*-table`、`*-column` 通配写法，如
- dataworks-project 工作空间
- dataworks-dataset dataworks数据集
- maxcompute-table maxcompute表
- *-column 所有字段类型
parameters.name: entity_types

parameters.help_en: The enumerated values. This applies only to custom attributes of the `enum` type. You can only append new values during an update
parameters.help_zh: 枚举可选值，仅ENUM类型支持；更新时仅支持追加枚举值
parameters.name: value_enums

parameters.help_en: Whether to display the custom attribute in the UI
parameters.name: display_enabled

parameters.help_en: Whether the custom attribute can be used as a filter condition
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持作为筛选条件
parameters.name: search_filter_enabled

parameters.help_en: The new description for the custom attribute. It must be 256 characters or less
parameters.help_zh: 新的自定义属性描述，长度小于256个字符
parameters.name: comment
